ABC Analysis is an approach for classifying items based on their classification value. The value is the total value of an item calculated over a specified time period. Example: If Last Week is used with an Anchor Week End Date of 6/5/2021 then the Last Week would aggregate sales for 5/30/2021 – 6/5/2021. Anchor Date definition may change depending on the fact selected. Snapshot Facts: Anchor Date is the date the snapshot was taken. Example: Open Orders Snapshot with an Anchor Date selection of 6/7/2021, the data represents what Open Orders were on 6/7/2021. Non-Snapshot Facts: Anchor Date is the last date of transactions included in the time period selected. Example: Invoice Sales with an Anchor Date selection of 6/7/2021, the data represents what shipped on or before 6/7/2021 for the time period selected.

Time Periods are pre-baked collections of dates that can be used with most facts. Time Periods will always default to look backwards from the most recent refresh of data. Time Period will be defined by the default or based on a filter selected in the Calendar Type dimension. For example, YTD for Invoice Sales or Standard Calendar will include Jan 1 - Dec 31. YTD for POS Sales or the Retail Calendar will include Week 1 - Week 52.
